The '''Coruscul system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscul]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The planet [[Coruscul]]<ref name="P104">{{PolyhedronCite|104|Dangers from the Dark Side: Villains for the Star Wars: New Republic Campaign, Part Two}} {{Un}}</ref> was the namesake of the Coruscul system.<ref name="TFN">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30422084|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=Senator_Cilghal|date=2009-09-11|time=5:52 PM}}</ref>
